text:
水社碼頭, sunset. The wannabe steps off the ferry, relaxed. Walks past the rental station (where the morning queue was) — it's empty now. Catches the 17:05 bus to 台中.
Instagram story posted: three photos. The bike path at 09:45. The food street at 13:00. The sunset from the ferry at 15:45. Caption: "Ride in the morning, ferry back for sunset. The perfect day." 500 likes. Six friends asking "how do I get there?"
The day 日月潭 was supposed to sell. And now, with 甲租乙還, it can.
